name: current-3d-engineering
description: Current-source 3D and graphics engineering across arbitrary project ecosystems.

interface.longDescription: Inspects the actual project, dependency provenance, toolchains, ownership boundaries, persisted content, and target environment; verifies current authoritative facts; and implements or reviews 3D and graphics software without predefined project scenarios or supported-technology lists.
defaultPrompt: Use Current 3D Engineering to implement this 3D feature against the architecture and toolchain already in my project.
Use Current 3D Engineering to diagnose this graphics issue using current authoritative sources while preserving my existing project state.
Use Current 3D Engineering to verify and safely change the dependencies, SDKs, toolchains, assets, or runtime components involved in this 3D work.
